description: Widens `emotion` from 6 values to the same 12-value vocabulary visual_plan's speaker_emotion/listener_emotion already use. Renderer support already exists (cartoon-scenes.ts's EMOTIONS set already lists all 12); the script layer was the bottleneck, forcing cartoon_visual_planner to re-derive nuance (skeptical, confused, amused, concerned, thinking, annoyed) from narration text instead of trusting the writer's own stated intent. No other shape change, so this is additive per RFC 0007: a script produced under 1.4.0 remains a valid instance of 1.5.0's superset enum.

point.description: What this beat does for the story.

speaker.description: character_id from the run's cast_roster who speaks this line. Absent for single-narrator scripts.

emotion.description: The speaker's emotional delivery for this line - drives the cartoon renderer's expression/pose choice, and is the visual planner's default speaker_emotion for this scene unless the direction genuinely needs a different nuance. Only meaningful alongside "speaker".
